title: Network Denoising Revisited: A Ricci-Flow-Inspired Graph Diffusion Method
abstract: arXiv:2608.16923v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Networks provide a fundamental representation of relationships among entities. However, real-world networks are often corrupted by noise caused by measurement errors and inherent stochasticity, hindering the discovery of meaningful structure. Most denoising methods rely on similarity-driven diffusion and ignore the non-Euclidean geometry of graphs, where local variations induce heterogeneous information transport. This motivates a geometric revisit of network denoising. In this work, we propose Ricci-Diffusion, a curvature-guided graph diffusion method inspired by Ricci flow. Specifically, Ricci-Diffusion exhibits a Ricci-flow-like evolution, in which relative edge-level curvature modulates local transport in the diffusion kernel and guides edge-weight updates toward a more regular graph geometry. translated_title: 网络去噪再探：一种受里奇流启发的图扩散方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16923v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：网络提供了实体间关系的基本表示。然而，现实世界中的网络常常因测量误差和固有随机性而受到噪声污染，阻碍了有意义结构的发现。大多数去噪方法依赖基于相似性的扩散，并忽略图的非欧几里得几何，其中局部变化会引发异质信息传输。这激发了对网络去噪的几何再审视。在这项工作中，我们提出了里奇扩散（Ricci-Diffusion），一种受里奇流启发的曲率引导图扩散方法。具体而言，里奇扩散展现出类似里奇流的演化过程，其中相对边缘级曲率调节扩散核中的局部传输，并引导边缘权重更新朝向更规则的图几何。我们进一步提供了理论分析，表明曲率能够区分常见基于相似性的扩散核所无法区分的图结构。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受里奇流启发的曲率引导图扩散方法（里奇扩散），利用边缘曲率调节局部传输并更新权重，以更有效地去噪，并理论证明了曲率能区分传统相似性扩散无法区分的图结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Ricci-flow-inspired curvature-guided graph diffusion method (Ricci-Diffusion) that modulates local transport and updates edge weights via curvature for more effective denoising, with theoretical evidence that curvature distinguishes graph structures beyond common similarity-driven diffusion.
